title: 设备身份摘要字段
command: printf 'HOSTNAME='; uname -n; printf 'ARCH='; uname -m; if [ -f /etc/version ]; then printf 'SOFTWARE_VERSION='; sed -n '1p' /etc/version; fi

title: 系统与权限
command: id -u; uname -a; uname -m; date; cat /proc/uptime

title: 型号与版本
command: for f in /proc/device-tree/model /etc/os-release /etc/version; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE $f"; sed -n "1,60p" "$f"; fi; done

title: CPU 与内存
command: cat /proc/cpuinfo; cat /proc/meminfo

title: 挂载与可写分区
command: cat /proc/mounts; df -k; cat /proc/mtd

title: 运行库与工具
command: ls -l /lib/ld* /lib/libc* /lib/libuClibc* /dev/net/tun; for app in sh busybox curl wget ip ifconfig route brctl iptables nft sha256sum tar dd wc sed awk readlink setsid nohup saf lxc-attach lxc-start; do echo "TOOL $app"; which "$app" 2>/dev/null || :; done

title: 网络接口（地址自动隐藏）
command: ip -4 addr show; ip -4 route show; ip rule show; brctl show; cat /proc/net/dev

title: 网络备用信息（地址自动隐藏）
command: ifconfig -a; route -n; ls -l /sys/class/net

title: 启动入口
command: for f in /etc/inittab /etc/rcS /etc/init.d/rcS /etc/rc.local /etc/default/S01userconfig; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE $f"; sed -n "1,160p" "$f"; fi; done

title: 启动脚本目录
command: ls -la /etc/rcS.d /etc/default /etc/init.d; ls -ld /usr/plugin /usr/tmp /usr/java /wlan /userconfig /usr/local/ct /saf /usr/local/saf /vasdocker /run /var/run

title: 候选入口与组件（只看元数据）
command: ls -l /wlan/wifi_debug.sh /etc/rc.local /usr/tmp/osgi.img /bin/pc /bin/cspd; for f in /bin/pc /bin/cspd; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; fi; done

title: 进程名称（不读取命令行）
command: for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$p/status" ] || continue; echo "PID ${p##*/}"; sed -n "/^Name:/p; /^State:/p; /^PPid:/p" "$p/status"; done

title: 已有 UU 安装与日志元数据
command: ls -ld /usr/plugin/uu-wol-f7615 /usr/plugin/uu-wol-backup /tmp/uu /tmp/uu-f7615-start.lock; ls -l /tmp/uu-f7615-service.log /tmp/uu-f7615-service.log.previous /tmp/uu-f7615-boot.log; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do e=$(readlink "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null) || continue; case "$e" in *uuplugin*|*xuplugin-guardian*) echo "PID ${p##*/} EXE $e"; ls -l "$p/fd/1" "$p/fd/2" ;; esac; done

title: 网络及驱动启动脚本（只读）
command: for f in /etc/rcS.d/S02wlan /etc/rcS.d/S30network /etc/rcS.d/S43BSPDriver /etc/rcS.d/S45BSP_power_and_driver_cap /etc/rcS.d/S99modules /etc/default/S01userconfig; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE $f"; sed -n "1,400p" "$f"; fi; done

title: 候选回调引用（只检测字符串，不执行）
command: ls -l /lib/*wlan* /lib/*wifi*; for f in /bin/cspd /bin/pc /lib/*wlan* /lib/*wifi* /lib/libcmapi.so; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; for word in wifi_debug.sh /wlan/ rc.local; do if grep -aqF "$word" "$f"; then echo "REFERENCE $f $word"; fi; done; done; echo CALLBACK_SCAN_DONE

title: 主启动脚本后续内容（不执行）
command: wc -l /etc/init.d/rcS; sed -n "161,1000p" /etc/init.d/rcS

title: 原厂服务启动脚本（不执行）
command: for f in /etc/rcS.d/S*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in */S02wlan|*/S30network|*/S43BSPDriver|*/S45BSP_power_and_driver_cap|*/S99modules) continue ;; esac; echo "FILE $f"; wc -l "$f"; sed -n "1,240p" "$f"; done

title: 插件与 Java 目录元数据（不读配置内容）
command: for d in /usr/java /usr/java/bin /usr/java/etc /usr/java/conf /usr/java/configuration /usr/java/bundle /usr/java/bundles /usr/java/felix /usr/plugin /usr/plugin/aosnet /usr/plugin/bvasPlug /usr/local/ct /var/felix-temp; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; echo "DIR $d"; ls -la "$d" | sed -n "1,100p"; done

title: Java 启动脚本（不执行）
command: for f in /usr/java/*.sh /usr/java/bin/*.sh /usr/java/felix/*.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; wc -l "$f"; sed -n "1,200p" "$f"; done; echo JAVA_SCRIPT_SCAN_DONE

title: 服务二进制中的启动路径引用（不执行）
command: for f in /bin/pc /bin/osgid /sbin/osgid /usr/bin/osgid /bin/cspd; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; sha256sum "$f"; LC_ALL=C grep -aoE "/(etc|usr/java|usr/plugin|usr/local/ct|var)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,160}" "$f" | sed -n "1,160p"; done; echo PATH_SCAN_DONE

title: 插件服务权限及可执行文件（不读命令行）
command: for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$p/status" ] || continue; if grep -qE "^Name:[[:space:]]*(java|osgid|pc|crond)$" "$p/status"; then echo "PID ${p##*/}"; sed -n "/^Name:/p; /^PPid:/p; /^Uid:/p; /^Gid:/p" "$p/status"; readlink "$p/exe"; readlink "$p/cwd"; fi; done; echo SERVICE_IDENTITY_DONE

title: 调度器与候选目录元数据（不读取任务内容）
command: for app in crond crontab run-parts; do echo "TOOL $app"; which "$app" 2>/dev/null || :; done; ls -ld /etc/crontabs /etc/cron.d /var/spool/cron /var/spool/cron/crontabs /etc/rc.local /usr/plugin/zte-f7005-boot-probe /wlan/wifi_debug.sh; echo SCHEDULER_SCAN_DONE

title: Felix 启动设置白名单（只读原厂框架文件）
command: for f in /usr/java/conf/config.properties /usr/java/conf/config_chongqinggd.properties; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; awk '/^[[:space:]]*(felix\.auto\.(deploy\.(dir|action)|start\.[0-9]+|install\.[0-9]+)|felix\.startlevel\.bundle|felix\.cache\.rootdir|org\.osgi\.framework\.(storage|startlevel\.beginning))[[:space:]]*[=:]/ {print; next} /^[[:space:]]*(felix\.auto\.|org\.osgi\.framework\.storage|felix\.cache\.rootdir)/ {print "OTHER_FRAMEWORK_KEY_PRESENT"}' "$f"; done; echo FRAMEWORK_PROPERTIES_DONE

title: 插件目录与预置清单元数据（不读取缓存内容）
command: for d in /usr/plugin/bdl /usr/plugin/bundlecache /usr/plugin/bundlecache/bundle0 /usr/java/regionconf /usr/plugin/hangyan /usr/plugin/BZ_sh /etc/BZ_sh; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; echo "DIR $d"; ls -la "$d" | sed -n "1,100p"; done; ls -l /usr/plugin/bundlecache/prebundle /usr/java/regionconf/prebundle.default; echo CATALOG_METADATA_DONE

title: 原生服务的插件启动字符串（只读）
command: for f in /bin/osgid /bin/pc /bin/cspd; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; LC_ALL=C grep -aoE '[ -~]{6,}' "$f" | grep -E 'hangyan/|BZ_sh/|felix[.]|prebundle|bundlelist|/usr/java/bin/java|/usr/plugin/bdl|osgi.*(start|exec)|crond|rc[.]local' | sed -n "1,180p"; done; echo NATIVE_START_HINTS_DONE

title: 可写插件目录的脚本路径引用（只读）
command: for f in /bin/cspd /bin/osgid /bin/pc; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "FILE $f"; LC_ALL=C grep -aoE '/usr/plugin/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]{1,160}' "$f" | grep -E '\.sh$|/bin/|/start|/run|/init|/exec' | sed -n "1,200p"; done; echo SCRIPT_PATHS_DONE

title: BusyBox 内置调度命令检测（不启动服务）
command: busybox --list | grep -E '^(crond|crontab|run-parts|od|hexdump|base64|strings)$'; echo BUSYBOX_APPLET_SCAN_DONE
